reference.title: Large settings inventories
reference.shortdesc: Use bounded-list behavior, search, filters, and categories when All settings contains a large policy and preference inventory.

section.title: Overview
section.p: All settings can expose many schema-backed policies and known preferences. Bounded lists keep the interface usable and make the next narrowing action explicit.

section.title: List budget
section.p: All settings may show a bounded subset, count, or continuation action instead of rendering every row at once.

section.title: Narrowing tools
section.p: Search, category navigation, source filters, and state filters are the supported ways to reduce a large inventory.

section.title: Performance boundary
section.p: Large-inventory handling is a UI boundary, not a signal that settings are missing from the profile or catalog.

section.title: Recovery
section.p: If the expected row is not visible, search by exact ID, clear filters, or switch between Configured and Catalog mode.
